gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 4050.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing from the end of PO TUNG ROAD and running in a north-easterly direction for about 2,480 metres and bends to run in a south-easterly direction for about 1,250 metres where it curves north-easterly for about 830 metres and bends to run in a south-easterly direction for about 880 metres, it then turns to run in a general north-easterly direction for about 2,680 metres where it bends south-easterly for about 850 metres and terminates at its junction with SAI KUNG MAN YEE ROAD and SAI KUNG SAI WAN ROAD as shown coloured purple on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R9A. Proposed Name: TAI MONG TSAI ROAD. Chinese Version: 大網仔路.

No. 4050.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with TAI MONG TSAI ROAD and SAI KUNG MAN YEE ROAD and running in a south-easterly direction for about 670 metres where it turns northerly for about 350 metres, it then bends to run generally in a south-easterly direction for about 2,420 metres where it curves generally in a northerly direction for about 840 metres and then bends south-easterly for about 130 metres, it then continues to run north-westerly for about 130 metres and bends south-westerly for about 240 metres where it changes to run southerly for about 70 metres to terminate at a closed end as shown coloured red on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R9A. Proposed Name: SAI KUNG SAI WAN ROAD. Chinese Version: 西貢西灣路.

No. 4050.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with TAI MONG TSAI ROAD and SAI KUNG SAI WAN ROAD and running south-easterly for about 4,840 metres and then it changes to run generally in an easterly direction for about 2,680 metres where it curves north-easterly for about 250 metres to terminate at a dam as shown coloured green on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R9A. Proposed Name: SAI KUNG MAN YEE ROAD. Chinese Version: 西貢萬宜路.

No. 4050.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with TAI MONG TSAI ROAD and running north-westerly for about 210 metres where it bends to run north-easterly for about 2,980 metres and it bends north-westerly for about 910 metres and then curves north-easterly for about 830 metres where it turns to run generally easterly for about 580 metres to terminate at WONG SHEK PIER as shown coloured yellow on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R9A. Proposed Name: PAK TAM ROAD. Chinese Version: 北潭路.

No. 4050.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Road commencing at its junction with PAK TAM ROAD and running generally in a north-westerly direction for about 2,450 metres where it bends north-easterly for about 1,280 metres to terminate at a closed end near Hoi Ha as shown coloured orange on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R9A. Proposed Name: HOI HA ROAD. Chinese Version: 海下路.
